description: Diagnose a domain's email authentication and DNS health with live lookups: SPF records (with include-chain DNS-lookup counting against RFC 7208's 10-lookup limit), DMARC policy enforcement, MX records (incl. null-MX detection), plus RDAP registration expiry, DNSSEC DS-record presence, and nameserver redundancy. Uses Cloudflare/Google DNS-over-HTTPS and rdap.org. No API key needed.
title: DNS Email Authentication Diagnostics
